JOINING VOLLEYBALL?
I'M KOTARO OKITA,
THE COACH! LET'S
HAVE A GREAT YEAR!

SHALL I EXPLAIN HOW
CLUB ACTIVITIES
WORK? WOULD YOU LIKE
TO HEAR IT?

HEAR EXPLANATION
SKIP EXPLANATION

ALL RIGHT. FIRST,
REMEMBER THAT THERE
ARE TWO KINDS OF
CLUB ACTIVITIES.

REGULAR ACTIVITIES,
AND SPECIAL PRACTICE
AT THE START OF EACH
MONTH.

FIRST, REGULAR CLUB
ACTIVITIES. THERE'S
NO SPECIAL TIME OR
ACTION TO CHOOSE.

JUST BEING IN A CLUB
GRADUALLY IMPROVES
THE ABILITIES THAT
SUIT THAT CLUB.

YOUR REGULAR GAINS
ARE REPORTED AT THE
START OF THE MONTH,
AT SPECIAL PRACTICE.

YOU CAN'T PUSH HARD
OR SLACK OFF DURING
THOSE GAINS, BUT
THEY BUILD STATS.

NEXT IS SPECIAL
PRACTICE. EACH CLUB
HOLDS THIS TRAINING
EVERY MONTH.

YOU CONCENTRATE ON
TRAINING THAT SUITS
YOUR CLUB'S
SPECIALTY.

SPECIAL PRACTICE IS
MUCH MORE EFFECTIVE
THAN REGULAR CLUB
ACTIVITIES.

IF YOU WANT A BIG
BOOST TO ONE STAT,
MAKE THE MOST OF
SPECIAL PRACTICE.

REGULAR ACTIVITIES
BUILD GENERAL STATS.
SPECIAL PRACTICE
FOCUSES ON ONE.

THAT'S HOW CLUB
TRAINING WORKS.

WOULD YOU LIKE ME TO
EXPLAIN IT AGAIN?

NO THANKS
HEAR IT AGAIN

ALL RIGHT, THAT'S
THE EXPLANATION
DONE. TODAY'S CLUB
VISIT ENDS HERE.
